name: Cassandra's Hoard
purpose: Observability for the local AI stack: which local services (the workspace, llama-server, Ollama, ComfyUI, the launcher and every Hoard app) are up, what went down and when, what else changed at that moment, what the logs said, what the GPUs were doing, and opt-in restarts.
notes: Keep the app running (python -m cassandra_hoard) so it keeps watching: the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server, never opens the database, and starts the app itself when it is not answering. Probable causes are heuristics: quote them as probable. svc_restart and svc_watch change things and are only for when the user asks; restart commands can only be set from the UI or data/services.json unless CASSANDRA_AGENT_COMMANDS=1.
